name: installer-durable-lane
title: Installer ships the discovery descriptor and the durable sd-review.yml lane
description: Make the consumer installer deliver the routed-review discovery descriptor and the durable workflow_dispatch review lane so consumer probes stop returning setup-descriptor-absent. Today config/routed-review-setup-v1.json is installed into no consumer repo, and the installer copies examples/pr-agent-router.yml to .github/workflows/ai-review-router.yml (the event-driven lane) rather than the .github/workflows/sd-review.yml workflow_dispatch lane the descriptor itself names. Also relocate this repository's own published descriptor off config/routed-review-setup-v1.json, the exact path consumers probe for an installed descriptor, so the router repository stops self-matching as an installed consumer, per collaboration-review contract item R1.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Blocked on 08-08-release-v0-3-0-pin-freshness. The new examples/sd-review.yml template carries a first-party pin; shipping it before the pin advance would bake v0.1.0 into the one workflow the whole fleet is about to receive. See prd.md Notes.
